fact: Benin's Cadre d'interopérabilité, a 32-page framework published by ASIN and instituted by décret n° 2020-209 of 18 March 2020, sets recommendations and referenced technical standards for interoperable government information systems (W3C SOAP/WSDL/XML/XSL/SVG/WCAG 2.0/CSS2/PNG, ISO 10918 JPEG, ISO/IEC 26300 ODF, MPEG4, RFC 1952, RFC 2306) and a catalogue of interoperability solutions; the PDF carries no publication date, so the decree date is a floor.

ASIN's July 2026 legal note treats Benin's interoperability framework as in place, setting registration, technical and contractual conditions for connecting to the Xroad-BJ exchange platform, with the Comité national d'interopérabilité supervising; the note's date is the published date, 2026-07-28, no event date being given.

ASIN held a sectoral consultation workshop in Cotonou on the draft Politique d'architecture des systèmes d'information de l'État (PASI), which sets organising principles, technical rules and standards to make public information systems interoperable, before final versions go to the Ministry of Digital Affairs.
